payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The edited image as a whole should read as a drawing made from chalk rather than as a photograph with only a chalk-like texture overlay. Assess the overall visual impression of the requested medium transformation, without requiring particular regions, subjects, or techniques to be independently transformed.
outcome.reference: Compare the input and edited images to judge whether the edited image as a whole convincingly reads as a chalk drawing. Consider visible chalk-like treatment and retained photographic appearance together; neither a particular technique nor retained detail alone determines completion.

check.question: Compared with the input image, does the edited image fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
check.complete_when: The edited image as a whole convincingly reads as a chalk drawing. Judge the overall impression of the medium transformation, weighing chalk-like appearance and any retained photographic qualities together; do not require uniform treatment or a particular technique, and do not treat retained detail alone as disqualifying.
check.partial_when: There is visible progress toward a chalk-drawing appearance, such as grain, softened outlines, or sketch-like treatment, but the overall image does not yet convincingly read as a chalk drawing. A superficial texture overlay may indicate progress without establishing completion.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence, from comparison with the input image, that no requested chalk-drawing transformation has occurred.
check.unknown_when: The input or edited image is unavailable, too unclear, or otherwise provides genuinely inadequate visual evidence to judge whether the transformation occurred. Do not use unknown merely to resolve a borderline judgment between complete and partial.
